title: Offline startup, bundled data licensing and dependency release governance

requirements.RC-1105: network is only required for genuinely network-bound monetization or external operations
requirements.RC-1106: calculation core has no network dependency
requirements.RC-1107: offline startup cannot wait indefinitely for network
requirements.RC-1108: local features can become ready before optional network work
requirements.RC-1109: city lookup is not dependent on a massive remote city API
requirements.RC-1110: city/country/timezone data can be bundled with the application
requirements.RC-1111: bundled runtime datasets require explicit commercial redistribution approval
requirements.RC-1112: required attribution must have an explicit attribution artifact
requirements.RC-1113: free availability alone is not treated as license approval
requirements.RC-1114: every bundled/external runtime dataset is present in the license inventory
requirements.RC-1115: every declared package dependency is present in the license inventory
requirements.RC-1116: review-sensitive reciprocal/commercial licenses are explicitly governed
requirements.RC-1117: astronomy runtime data/engines cannot be embedded without license review
requirements.RC-1118: AKILES verification material is QA-only unless separately runtime-approved
requirements.RC-1119: runtime no-cost target requires legally redistributable algorithms/data
requirements.RC-1120: Swiss Ephemeris-style references remain QA-only unless runtime licensing is separately approved
requirements.RC-1121: controlled code and legally distributable bundled data are preferred runtime foundations
requirements.RC-1122: core startup/calculation does not depend on third-party pricing/network availability
requirements.RC-1123: dependency resolution is locked by pubspec.lock before release
requirements.RC-1124: uncontrolled latest/any/wildcard dependency constraints are forbidden
requirements.RC-1125: dependency updates cannot enter production automatically
requirements.RC-1127: dependency changes must pass calculation regression
requirements.RC-1128: dependency changes must pass PDF regression
requirements.RC-1129: dependency changes must pass backup round-trip regression
requirements.RC-1130: only after all dependency gates are green may release promotion proceed

promotion_policy: Implementation may be recorded while blockers remain. TESTED/VERIFIED/DONE are forbidden until pubspec.lock is materialized, all runtime dataset/dependency licensing is resolved, offline device startup is proven, calculation/PDF/backup regressions are green and exact-release evidence exists.
